title: AHB Reset Assertion and Legal Restart
description: Observe asynchronous HRESETn assertion between sampling edges, synchronous deassertion after a rising HCLK edge, required IDLE while reset is active, and one legal implementation choice for restarting traffic.

annotations.message: Before reset, the bus can carry a normal NONSEQ transfer.
HRESETn asserted asynchronously between sampling edges and is observed LOW here. While reset is active, the master drives HTRANS=IDLE and all address/control outputs to valid levels.
Reset remains active. Each component must observe reset for its declared minimum duration; AHB does not define one universal cycle count.
HRESETn deassertion is observed synchronously after a rising HCLK edge. This trace chooses IDLE here, but AHB does not mandate an extra full IDLE cycle after release.
Once the component's reset requirements are satisfied, a first legal transfer starts with HTRANS=NONSEQ and valid address/control.
